_about: Everything compiled into the WebAssembly engines, pinned. build.js writes the release SBOM (libVES-<version>.cdx.json) from this file, so a version change here is a change to the SBOM. The engines' build steps are in WasmOQS/Makefile and WasmECDH/Makefile, and build-release.sh runs them. tools.image is the emscripten image repro/reproduce.sh and its GitHub workflow rebuild a release in.

components.name: liboqs
components.licenseNote: liboqs is MIT; some modules in its source tree carry their own licenses, in their folders

components.name: openssl
components.build: libcrypto only, configured as in WasmECDH/Makefile

components.name: emscripten
components.build: the runtime linked into each engine: JS glue, libc, malloc, compiler builtins

components.name: compiler-rt
components.licenseNote: LLVM's compiler-rt as copied into emscripten's tree; built with clang 23.0.0git (llvm-project 7b58716d)

vex.detail: The bug is in musl's iconv EUC-KR decoder. Neither engine calls iconv (nothing in liboqs, OpenSSL or the engine sources does), so it is not linked in; Emscripten 5.0.7's copy of the decoder also has the corrected bounds check. Checked 2026-11-04.
